system.flavor:
Pull a friend out from under a falling scaffold, drag someone back from a cart that will not stop, yank a child clear of a snapped rope, or haul a companion out of a gas-filled cellar. One person moved out of harm's path.

Not enough to move a group, carry anyone far, or stop what was falling.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move it 1 unit along a clear path, then recheck the area.

surges.html: If still affected, grant +1 to its targeted Defense against that Action.
